summary: Setup and update messages now tell you exactly what happened and what to do.

fixes.title: Updater shows the real version
fixes.text: The update log now shows the running version, or says why it is unknown, instead of a long code.

fixes.title: Clear reason when Azure refuses setup
fixes.text: When a policy blocks public network access, setup stops with Azure's own message and points to the private endpoint.

fixes.title: Mail sender setup stays time-bound
fixes.text: Setup explains how to assign Exchange Administrator manually and time-bound, and flags an assignment that runs longer as standing privilege.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Clearer guidance for signed-in setup on Azure VM hosts, and managed tenants name the version they pulled.
